declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = '' if @ma_phi <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_phi like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_phi) + '%''' if @strDetailKey <> '' set @strDetailKey = ' and exists(select 1 from v611 x where a.id = x.id ' + @strDetailKey + ')'
---select @strFinding = '1=1' set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + @strDetailKey if @@admin = 0 set @strKey = @strKey + ' and exists(select 1 from kbnguoiduyet y where y.user_id = @@userId and y.status = 1 and y.loai = 1 and a.ma_nt = y.ma_nt and (y.tien = 0 or a.t_tt_nt <= y.tien))' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join dmkhobai d on a.ma_noi_di = d.ma_kho left join dmkhobai f on a.ma_noi_den = f.ma_kho left join dmkh k on a.ma_hang = k.ma_kh', 'c.ten_kh, d.ten_kho ten_noi_di, f.ten_kho ten_noi_den,k.ten_kh ten_hang ', '@@key',@strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId

dir.script:
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case @xstatus when 5 then 7 when 7 then 5 else 7 end --else 9 - Huy thi tra ve duyet set @uid = case when @xstatus = 5 then @@userId else 0 end set @dduyet = case when @xstatus = 5 then getdate() else null end
update s611 set status = @deststatus, user_id_duyet = @uid, ngay_duyet = @dduyet where id in (select id from @tblKeys) update v611 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys)
DECLARE @id_yc TABLE(id int) insert into @id_yc select id_yc from s611 where id in (select id from @tblKeys)
update s11 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @id_yc) update v11 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @id_yc) select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case when @xstatus = 5 then 9 else 7 end
update s611 set status = @deststatus, ly_do_huy = @ly_do_huy where id in (select id from @tblKeys) update v611 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys) select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
&VoucherJSLoading;
